applicability: UCB1 upper-confidence-bound score for ranking a candidate next experiment, gated by a separately-evaluated risk-gate flag
assumptions: a stationary (non-changing over time) reward distribution per arm
the risk gate result is still valid at the moment the experiment is actually executed
uncertainty: Standard textbook multi-armed-bandit algorithm (Auer, Cesa-Bianchi & Fischer 2002); hand-verified before use (mean=0.5,total=100,arm=10 -> score=1.4597; arm=50 -> score=0.9292).
limits_policy: A failed risk gate blocks the experiment regardless of UCB score; the score never overrides risk authority.
